findings.desc: CHK-002 adversarial verificationIntent says a run must HARD_FAIL when lifecycle evidence linkage drops below 1, but the recorded verificationEvidence points to memory-benchmark-smoke and that smoke test only asserts the happy-path value equals 1.0; it never exercises a <1 linkage override or checks the resulting HARD_FAIL, so this must-intent branch is not mechanically covered.
